# Site components, presets and effects

Presets are insertable copies (theme presets and the site's own library). Site components are reusable subtrees with exposed props: every instance follows the component. Effects are saved visual effects nodes can use.

[`preset.list`](#presetlist) · [`preset.insert`](#presetinsert) · [`preset.save`](#presetsave) · [`preset.rename`](#presetrename) · [`preset.delete`](#presetdelete) · [`component.list`](#componentlist) · [`component.createFromNode`](#componentcreatefromnode) · [`component.update`](#componentupdate) · [`component.instantiate`](#componentinstantiate) · [`component.detach`](#componentdetach) · [`effect.list`](#effectlist) · [`effect.save`](#effectsave) · [`effect.delete`](#effectdelete) · [`preset.index`](#presetindex) · [`preset.read`](#presetread)

## preset.list

List the presets the site can insert, theme presets first, then the site library; each with its tree.

- permission `site.read` (admin, editor); class `read`; writes nothing.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | "section" \| "box" \| "element" |  |
| `source` | "theme" \| "site" |  |

Output: ({ source: "theme" \| "site", id: string, kind: "section" \| "box" \| "element", label: string (min 1, max 80), keywords?: string (min 1, max 40)[] (≤16), category: string, description?: string (max 280), thumbnail?: string, page?: { scroll: { mode: "snap-y", snapType: "mandatory" \| "proximity" } }, scenes?: ({ trigger: {… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"kind":"section"}
```

> Answers every preset with its whole tree: use `preset.index` (or the `presets` resource) to choose, then `preset.read` for one.

## preset.insert

Insert a fresh copy of a theme or site preset (section, group or element) into a page or a region. A section preset goes under a tree's root: in a region (header or footer), `parentId` is the region root, the root id `region.read` answers, never a section inside the region, which is refused as I5.section_placement. An element or box preset asked for under the root is wrapped in a new section (the answer's nodeId is the section); elsewhere it goes where asked. The batch is atomic, so one refused insert fails the whole batch.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `tree:{pageId}`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `parentId` | nodeId | yes |
| `index` | integer ≥0 | yes |
| `kind` | "section" \| "box" \| "element" | yes |
| `presetId` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `source` | "theme" \| "site" |  |

Output: { revision: integer ≥0, inverse: ({ op: "insert", parentId: nodeId, slot?: string, index: integer ≥0, node: { meta?: …, styles?: …, variant?: …, theme?: …, visibility?: …, attrs?: …, id: …, kind: …, type: …, children: … } \| { meta?: …, styles?: …, variant?: …, theme?: …, visibility?: …, attrs?: …, id: …, slot?: …, name… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f","parentId":"root0000","index":0,"kind":"section","presetId":"hero-split","source":"theme"}
```

> A section preset goes under a tree root: the page root, or a region root from `region.read`. A section inside a region is refused as `I5.section_placement`. The answer's `nodeId` is the new node.

## preset.delete

Delete a preset from the site library; pages that inserted it keep their copies.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `presets`; needs `"confirmed": ["destructive"]`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `presetId` | string | yes |

Output: { success: true }

Example input:

```json
{"presetId":"claim-band"}
```

## component.detach

Replace an instance with a plain copy of the subtree it renders, overrides applied and fresh ids; it no longer follows the component. The component's motion does not follow the copy.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `tree:{pageId}`; undoable with `history.undo`.

| Input | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | string (min 1) | yes |
| `nodeId` | nodeId | yes |

Output: { revision: integer ≥0, inverse: ({ op: "insert", parentId: nodeId, slot?: string, index: integer ≥0, node: { meta?: …, styles?: …, variant?: …, theme?: …, visibility?: …, attrs?: …, id: …, kind: …, type: …, children: … } \| { meta?: …, styles?: …, variant?: …, theme?: …, visibility?: …, attrs?: …, id: …, slot?: …, name… (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{"pageId":"6f1d2c3b-4a59-4e8d-9c7b-1a2b3c4d5e6f","nodeId":"claim001"}
```

## effect.list

List the effect presets the editor offers, the built-in effects first, then the site's own: each a reveal (meta.reveal), transitions (one `transition` value in `scope`, base when absent) or both. Apply one with tree.commit: set_meta with the reveal, set_style with the transitions.

- permission `site.read` (admin, editor); class `read`; writes nothing.
- Input: `{}`.

Output: ({ id: string, label: string (min 1, max 80), reveal?: { effect: "fade" \| "fade-up" \| "fade-down" \| "fade-left" \| "fade-right" \| "scale" \| "blur", distance?: number ≥0 ≤400, mode?: "enter", once: boolean, threshold: number ≥0 ≤1, durationMs?: integer ≥0 ≤5000, staggerChildren: boolean, stagger?: integer ≥0 ≤1000 } \| { … (full schema: discover_operations)

Example input:

```json
{}
```

## effect.save

Save the reveal and the transition declarations of a page node as a site effect preset. The transitions are read from `scope`, else from the first scope of the node that declares one; a node with neither is refused.

- permission `site.edit` (admin, editor); class `transaction`; writes `presets`; undoable with `history.undo`.

|---|---|---|
| `pageId` | string (min 1) | yes |

